content: The first condition which we test is the sentiment change in conversation threads, comparing the initial and final sentiment scores (i.e. posts' scores) of the original poster. The results of the analysis are presented in Figure FIGREF33. In the figure we can observe that the distribution of the sentiment change in the two datasets is different. While in Twitter the amount of conversations that lead to the increase of sentiment score is roughly equal to the amount of conversations that lead to the decrease of sentiment score; the situation is different for OSG. In OSG, the amount of conversations that lead to the increase of sentiment score is considerably higher.
